# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 9 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in 1QH Column 9 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 9:1 — "galita oznai" — "opened my ear" vs. "unsealed my ear"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "opened my ear" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "unsealed my ear" | Revelation imagery |
| PNEUMA | "opened my ears" | Plural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "opened my ear." Simple, biblical, singular.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 9:4 — "davaqti" — "clung to" vs. "held fast to"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "clung to" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "held fast to" | Dignified |
| PNEUMA | "held on tight to" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "held fast to." More dignified for covenantal language.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:7 — "marpeh / 'ormah" — healing and prudence terms

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "healing" and "prudence" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "a remedy" and "discernment" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "a source of healing" and "good sense" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Blend: "healing" (EMET) for directness, "discernment" (LOGOS) for precision.

**Status:** Resolved as SOPHIA blend.

---

## 9:8 — "cherpah / qeles" — "reproach and derision" vs. "taunt and mockery"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a reproach and derision" | Biblical register |
| LOGOS | "a taunt and mockery" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "an insult and a joke" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "a reproach and derision." Traditional biblical English.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 9:11 — "ha-rabbim" — verb and noun rendering

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "illuminated the faces of the Many" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "caused the faces of the Many to shine" | Aaronic echo |
| PNEUMA | "made the faces of the community shine" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "caused the faces of the Many to shine." Aaronic blessing allusion.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:17 — "me-rechem" — birth-sinfulness phrase

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "in iniquity from the womb" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "it abides in iniquity from the womb" | Expanded |
| PNEUMA | "sits in wrongdoing from the moment of birth" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "it abides in iniquity from the womb." "Abides" conveys permanence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:18 — "tamim" — "perfect" vs. "blameless" vs. "flawless"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a perfect way" | Traditional |
| LOGOS | "a blameless way" | More precise |
| PNEUMA | "a flawless path" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "a blameless way." tamim means "complete/blameless."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:22 — "benei retsono" — "good-pleasure" vs. "favor"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "His good-pleasure" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "His favor" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "whom God has chosen to favor" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "His favor." Concise and clear.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:29 — "qamti va-e'emodah" — rising and standing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I rose and stood" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "I rose and stood firm" | Added emphasis |
| PNEUMA | "I got back on my feet and stood firm" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "I rose and stood firm." Emphatic hitpael force.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 9:37 — "yada'ti" — "have known" vs. "have come to know"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "have known" | Simple |
| LOGOS | "have come to know" | Experiential |
| PNEUMA | "have learned" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "have come to know." Experiential, revelatory.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements in Column 9: 10**
